Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (including streaming releases). I’ve grouped them by release platform and added a short note on why each one stands out.

| Platform | Film | Why it’s worth watching |
|----------|------|------------------------|
| **Theatrical** | **“The Little Things” (2021)** – *Note: Released in late 2020 in some markets* | A gritty, atmospheric hunt for a serial killer, featuring strong performances by Denzel Washington, Rami Malek, and Jared Leto. The film’s slow‑burn tension and moral ambiguity make it a standout in the genre. |
| | **“The Hunt” (2020)** | A tense thriller about a man who becomes the target of a violent online conspiracy. It blends social media paranoia with classic cat‑and‑mouse suspense. |
| | **“The Nightingale” (2020)** | Though more of a period drama, its plot revolves around a revenge‑driven hunt across the Australian outback, delivering a tense, atmospheric narrative. |
| | **“The Invisible Man” (2020)** | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a strong psychological thriller edge. It’s praised for its smart pacing and strong female lead. |
| | **“The Last Full Measure” (2020)** | A war‑drama with thriller elements, focusing on a soldier’s quest for justice after a battlefield tragedy. It’s a gripping, emotionally charged narrative. |
